collections.title: Watch Roll Collection
collections.description:
A refined collection of handcrafted watch rolls designed for collectors who value style. Featuring carefully selected heritage fabrics paired with premium leather accents.

Available in multiple fabric patterns and color combinations, every watch roll is lined with a soft interior and thoughtfully constructed to keep your watches protected on the move.

Timeless craftsmanship. Everyday practicality. Designed for the modern collector.

Grey Tartan Check | Beige & Black
products.description_text:
The Grey Tartan Check Fabric & Grey Leather Watch Roll blends classic tartan fabric with refined grey leather accents. Designed to hold up to three watches, it features a soft charcoal suede lining, cushioned compartments, and an embroidered “TM” monogram for secure and stylish storage on the go.

Please note that layout variations may differ from the version shown in the product images.

products.title: Pepita Houndstooth | Black & White
products.description_text:
Meet your new travel essential — the Pepita Houndstooth Fabric (Black & White) & Tan Leather Watch Roll. Designed to hold up to three watches, it features a timeless black-and-white houndstooth exterior with refined cognac leather accents.

Inside, a soft terracotta suede lining and padded cushions keep your timepieces protected and secure, while gold-tone snap closures ensure everything stays in place.

Perfect for travel or display, the Pepita Houndstooth Fabric is crafted for those who appreciate thoughtful detail.
